gitCommit.subject: Fix 10 open security findings (8 Dependabot + 2 CodeQL)
gitCommit.body:
Fix 10 open security findings (8 Dependabot + 2 CodeQL)

npm audit fix resolves all 7 fixable Dependabot advisories (vite, vitest, @vitest/coverage-v8, esbuild, postcss, ws, brace-expansion) within existing semver ranges. Fixes js/incomplete-url-substring-sanitization in background.js (exact hostname check via URL parsing instead of two startsWith prefix checks) with a regression test. Fixes actions/missing-workflow-permissions in package-chrome.yml. Patch bump to 1.4.3.
